# Security

This repository contains a public profile README, documentation, and SVG assets.

## Reporting

Please avoid reporting security-sensitive details in a public issue. Contact Juanpablo privately through the LinkedIn profile linked in the [README](../README.md). Include the affected file or link, a concise description, and steps to reproduce when safe to do so.

Do not include passwords, tokens, or other secrets in a report. Public disclosure should wait until the concern has been reviewed.
